call_points.text: Opening order book for FY27 stands at ~₹310 Cr, which provides strong revenue visibility.
FY26 order inflows reached ~₹530 Cr across defence and civil customers, the highest annual booking in history.
Management expects blended margin structure for FY27 to be roughly 50% to 55%.
Extending technology into combat drones, loitering munitions, and kamikaze systems via partnerships rather than seeking ammunition licenses.
Delivered EW resilient systems after real-world customer acceptance testing in contested environments.
Global supply chain around thermal imagers remains a constrained challenge for production.
Received maiden US order from Lamar Police Department and became the first Indian drone maker to train NATO forces.
Added ~₹530 Cr to order book in FY26, entering FY27 with ~₹310 Cr open orders.
Executed 40% of open orders in Q4FY26 despite geopolitical supply chain headwinds.
Closed Q4 with positive PAT and full-year FY26 with positive EBITDA.
Delivered Electronic Warfare resilient systems, shifting them from demonstration to deployed capability.
Secured inaugural US order from Lamar Police Department.
Actively developing combat drones including long-range attack, loitering munitions, and kamikaze systems.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹141.04 Cr; net profit ₹59.99 Cr (against a loss of ₹25.71 Cr a year earlier).
ideaForge published Q4FY26 presentation highlighting ~₹530 Cr FY26 order bookings, positive full-year EBITDA, and an opening order book of ~₹314 Cr.
NILESH RANJAN JAYWANT, Director of ideaForge Technology Limited, shared the earnings call recording link for Q4FY26 and FY26 on May 4, 2026.
ideaForge held its Q4FY26 concall, guiding for 50-55% blended margin in FY27 and execution of ₹310 Cr order book in 3 quarters.
CRISIL revised ideaForge Technology's corporate credit rating outlook to Stable from Negative on May 27, 2026.
Ankit Mehta, Promoter and Whole-time Director, confirmed no promoter or group encumbrances on Ideaforge Technology shares for FY2026 under SEBI Reg. 31(4).
ideaForge Technology board approved raising up to ₹500 Cr through equity or other eligible securities via QIP, preferential allotment, or private placement.
ideaForge Technology issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval to raise up to ₹500 Cr via QIP or other securities.
India Ratings assigned ideaForge Technology a long-term issuer rating of IND BBB with a Stable outlook.
ideaForge Technology released its corporate presentation in June 2026, outlining its global market standing, patent portfolio, and technological capabilities.
